title: Universal Senior Citizen Security Disability Pension and Care Guarantee Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal enforcing a universal non-contributory pension (min ₹3,000 indexed to inflation) for all senior citizens and persons with severe disabilities, free assisted living centers, and doorstep delivery of essential medicines and assistive devices.
notes: Matter 027: Universal Senior Citizen Security Disability Pension and Care Guarantee Bill, 2026.
